# Warm Springs

Warm Springs takes its earthy palette from the Warm Springs farm in Sonoma, combining dark chocolate backgrounds with cream highlights, desaturated greens and muted rust and clay accents. Both light and dark modes are provided, and a dusty rose accent is retained in each for cohesive emphasis.

![Warm Springs screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brtmax/obsidian-warm-springs/HEAD/warm-springs-preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Warm Springs"
    author: "brtmax"
    repo:   "brtmax/obsidian-warm-springs"
    slug:   "warm-springs"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/warm-springs"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/brtmax/obsidian-warm-springs"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brtmax/obsidian-warm-springs/HEAD/warm-springs-preview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a warm, earthy color palette inspired by Sonoma's Warm Springs farm, with dark chocolate backgrounds, cream highlights, desaturated greens, and muted rust and clay accents. Switch between light and dark modes while retaining a dusty rose accent for cohesive emphasis."
}
```
